text: OVERDOSAGE Signs and Symptoms Toxic effects accompanying acute overdosage of clomiphene citrate have not been reported. Signs and symptoms of overdosage as a result of the use of more than the recommended dose during clomiphene citrate therapy include nausea, vomiting, vasomotor flushes, visual blurring, spots or flashes, scotomata, ovarian enlargement with pelvic or abdominal pain. (See CONTRAINDICATIONS : Ovarian Cyst .) Oral LD 50 . The acute oral LD 50 of clomiphene citrate is 1700 mg/kg in mice and 5750 mg/kg in rats. The toxic dose in humans is not known. Dialysis. It is not known if clomiphene citrate is dialyzable. Treatment In the event of overdose, appropriate supportive measures should be employed in addition to gastrointestinal decontamination.
